positions.title: Competitive Hearthstone Player
positions.description:
Hearthstone is a competitive strategy game, with millions of players worldwide
- $15k career earnings
- Received scholarship from Northeastern for varsity Hearthstone
- National Champion, Spring 2020
--- https://twitter.com/ClickStartU/status/1285244873684197376
- Led Northeastern to a record 5 consecutive top 16 national collegiate championship appearances, earning more than $5000 in scholarship prize money
--- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dmPd-zJYPE8
- Qualified for 8 Masters Tours - professional tournaments with several hundred players and $250k-500k prize pools 
- Peaked at #1 on Americas server during December 2019
- Finished top 50 legend for November 2019 (JustinTime), which is roughly top 0.0025% of active players
--- https://playhearthstone.com/en-us/community/leaderboards?region=US&leaderboardId=STD&seasonId=73&page=2
- High-profile enough to have a dedicated liquipedia page, an esports community wiki https://liquipedia.net/hearthstone/JustinTime
